name: Edge Three-Coloring
description: You are given an undirected connected graph with $$$n$$$ vertices and $$$m$$$ edges, where $$$m \le n + 9$$$. Each edge of the graph must be colored with one of three colors numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$3$$$. We say that vertices $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$ are reachable in color $$$c$$$ if there exists a path from $$$u$$$ to $$$v$$$ consisting only of edges of color $$$c$$$. Determine whether there exists a way to color the edges such that the following conditions are satisfied: for each color, there is at least one edge painted in that color; for every pair of colors $$$i$$$ and $$$j$$$ and every pair of vertices $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$, the following holds: if $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$ are reachable in color $$$i$$$ and $$$i \lt j$$$, then they are also reachable in color $$$j$$$.
input_specification: The first line contains one integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$) — the number of test cases. Each test case begins with a line that contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$m$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 3000$$$; $$$n - 1 \le m \le n + 9$$$) — the number of vertices and edges in the graph. Each of the next $$$m$$$ lines of a test case contains two integers $$$u_i$$$ and $$$v_i$$$ ($$$1 \le u_i, v_i \le n$$$, $$$u_i \ne v_i$$$) — the endpoints of the $$$i$$$-th edge. Additional constraints on the input: the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$3000$$$; in each test case, the graph has no self-loops or multiple edges; in each test case, the graph is connected.
output_specification: For each test case, print the answer as follows: if such an edge coloring exists, print YES ; otherwise, print NO . Each letter may be printed in any case.
approach_summary: Precompute 2^k ancestor jumps up[u][k] and node depths in O(N log N). Compute LCA and path aggregates in O(log N) per query.
